title: C2P: Dissect the remote API packet type

notes.body:
dissect_c2p_api(tvbuff_t
To go with the convention.

None of the other static functions in this file has c2p in their name. E.g:

```c
static int dissect_dsrc_rx(tvbuff_t* tvb, proto_tree* c2p_tree, packet_info* pinfo)
static int dissect_dsrc_tx(tvbuff_t* tvb, proto_tree* c2p_tree, packet_info* pinfo)
static int dissect_nav(tvbuff_t* tvb, proto_tree* c2p_tree)
```

So I'd either leave this new api dissector function as-is or change all the other function names as well. Which one do you prefer?
